description.value: Table: Summon Nature's Ally V Creature Subtype(s) Antlion (1/day Venom Spray) — Baretta — Black Lizard (1/day Breath) (Reptilian) Elemental (Large) (Elemental, Extraplanar) Elf Toad — Devourer (Aquatic) Great Tortoise (1/day Breath) (Reptilian) Hippogriff (1/day Peacock) — Killer Bee — Killer Shark (Aquatic) Lab Rat — Rattlesnake (Reptilian) Red Claw — Saberclaw — Sea Snake (Reptilian) Vampire Bat (Avian) Winter Wolf (1/day Breath) (Ice) Wisp, Blue (4 MP) (Water) Wisp, Red (4 MP) (Fire) Wisp, Green (4 MP) (Wind) This spell functions like Summon Nature’s Ally I , except that you can summon one creature from the 5th-level list with a CR rating of 6 or lower, 1d3 creatures of the same kind from the 4th-level list , or 1d4+1 creatures of the same kind from the 3rd-level or lower lists.
